lyrics:
[Intro: warm analog synth chords, soft drum machine]

[Verse 1: gentle, low, reflective]
Just one more look before I merge
The water tower, the college church
I knew a kid who lived round here
He had my face and half my fear

[Pre-Chorus: bass enters, drums build]
He's on the corner in a coat too thin
I slow the car to let him in

[Chorus: full band, one long soaring line]
And when I'm back in that zip code, I see him
Another one of me, still dreaming
He's twenty-four and he's got no idea
I honk the horn and I wave
And I leave him here

[Verse 2: gentle, a little warmer]
The bar's a bank, the bank's a gym
The song they played still sounds like him
I could tell him how it all turns out
He wouldn't listen, he'd find out

[Pre-Chorus: bass and drums build]
He's on the corner looking at the sky
I think he saw me driving by

[Chorus: full band, one long soaring line]
And when I'm back in that zip code, I see him
Another one of me, still dreaming
He's twenty-four and he's got no idea
I honk the horn and I wave
And I leave him here

[Bridge: synths swell, guitar feedback, voice rising]
You take the man out of the town
You take the town out of the man
You can't, you can't

[Final Chorus: biggest, guitars, held last note]
And when I'm back in that zip code, I see him
Another one of me, still dreaming
He's twenty-four and he's got no idea
I honk the horn and I wave
And I leave him here

[Outro: synth chords, a car indicator ticking, fade]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 80 BPM, 4/4, D major. Slow, warm and patient, growing into something wide and bright.

VOICE: Male baritone, gentle and slightly hazy in the verses, as if thinking aloud. In the chorus he lifts into a higher, stronger, sustained line with a slight strain that makes it feel reached for. Doubled in the chorus. A held note at the end of the last chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: Warm, slightly wobbly analog synthesiser chords. A soft drum machine that gives way to a live kit in the choruses. A round, steady bass. Clean, chiming electric guitar. A fuzzy lead guitar and feedback in the bridge and final chorus. A high, simple synth melody.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, synth chords and drum machine. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:36 Pre-chorus. 0:48 Chorus 1. 1:12 Verse 2. 1:36 Pre-chorus. 1:48 Chorus 2. 2:12 Bridge, building with feedback. 2:24 Final chorus with guitars and a held last note. 2:44 Outro, synth chords and a car indicator ticking, fading by 2:55.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2020s psychedelic synth-rock: warm, soft-focus and wide, with tape-like wobble on the keys and a big, open chorus.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The first line of the chorus, when the voice lifts and the live drums arrive at 0:48.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original was written a few years after leaving. This is thirty years after: the bar is a bank, and he knows the kid would not listen. He waves and drives on, which is kinder than going back.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Curiosity, tenderness toward a younger self, letting go.
